references.scope: Read key definitions §§3.1–3.2, primitive/scheme distinction §5, range checks §§5.1.1–5.1.2, OAEP overview §7.1 and signature overview §8; next read PSS overview before revising. Not full RFC.
Read §1.2 static RSA removal and E.8 RSA key-transport distinction; not full RFC or current web prevalence measurements.
Read pow integer/modulus/inverse and Python3.8 introduction; actual runtime3.12.14. Not a constant-time or fixed-duration assurance.
Read abstract/metadata only: polynomial steps in input size on hypothetical quantum computer; not full paper or hardware forecasts.

findings: 2048-bit sentence assigns size to primes instead of modulus; unsupported trillions-of-years/age-of-universe timing estimates.
Absolute impossibility and mathematically-proven factoring-hardness claims; raw deterministic RSA lacks scheme security and authentication.
Euler proof covers coprime representatives only despite algorithm range0..N-1; add primewise zero/nonzero proof and CRT.
Natural-number factorization needs positive>1 scope (1 empty product,0 excluded); arbitrary integer k can introduce undefined negative powers.
Raw signature described as private-key encryption and asserted unforgeability; trivial public forgery reproduced.
Key definition should distinguish exponent from full(n,d) key, distinct odd primes, and educational phi inverse from standard lambda condition.
Python toy runs but unguarded pow wraps out-of-range representatives; fixed execution-time assertions unsupported.
Quantum algorithm polynomial complexity does not mean instantaneous or certify any PQC as impossible to break.
English Crypto/Euclide substring links and unreviewed biography targets; review link scope without counting dependency articles.
